title: Survival and default probabilities from a piecewise-constant hazard
source:
"""Survival curve under a piecewise-constant hazard.

S(T) = exp(-sum_k h_k * (t_k - t_{k-1})) over segments up to T, t_0 = 0.
cumulative_default = 1 - S(T).

ASSUMPTION (the instruction states two readings of "marginal"): the column
table defines it as "the increment over the previous tenor", i.e. the
unconditional probability of defaulting inside the segment,
S(t_{k-1}) - S(t_k). That reading makes the marginals sum to the cumulative
default probability, which is asserted. The conditional reading
1 - S(t_k)/S(t_{k-1}) would not sum; it is not used.
"""
import os

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

INPUT = "/input/environment/data/hazard_curve.csv"
OUT = "/app/output/survival_curve.parquet"


def main() -> None:
    curve = pd.read_csv(INPUT)
    order = curve.sort_values("tenor_years").reset_index(drop=True)
    t = order["tenor_years"].to_numpy(float)
    h = order["hazard_rate"].to_numpy(float)
    seg = np.diff(np.concatenate([[0.0], t]))
    survival = np.exp(-np.cumsum(h * seg))
    cumulative = 1.0 - survival
    prev = np.concatenate([[1.0], survival[:-1]])
    marginal = prev - survival

    assert np.all(np.diff(survival) <= 1e-15), "survival cannot rise"
    assert abs(marginal.sum() - cumulative[-1]) < 1e-14

    out = pd.DataFrame({"tenor_years": order["tenor_years"], "survival_probability": survival,
                        "cumulative_default_probability": cumulative,
                        "marginal_default_probability": marginal})
    out = out.set_index("tenor_years").loc[curve["tenor_years"]].reset_index()   # input row order
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT), exist_ok=True)
    out.to_parquet(OUT, index=False)
    assert len(pd.read_parquet(OUT)) == len(curve)
    print(out.head())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
